QuickPick final class

The QuickPick — fuzzy finder / quick-pick overlay component.

MethodSummary
__construct(array $items = [], ?\Closure $itemFormatter = null, ?\Closure $filterFn = null)All three seeds are factory-reachable through new() as well (S-28/-056); the fluent path is the filterFn builder — withFilterFn() today, canonically withFilterFn() after the naming sweep (S-24).
static new(array $items = [], ?\Closure $itemFormatter = null, ?\Closure $filterFn = null): self
withItems(array $items): selfReplace the item list.
withPrompt(string $prompt): self
withMatchStyle(string $ansiStyle): self
withWindowHeight(int $h): selfSet the overlay window height in ROWS of the frame — header and separator included, so the visible item count is $h - 2, minus one more row when the overflow marker is needed. The marker shows only when it fits inside the window: if reserving its row would empty the list band, the marker is suppressed rather than growing the frame (-002).
withWindowWidth(int $w): selfSet the overlay width in cells.
withOffset(int $x, int $y): selfPosition the overlay at (x, y) cells into the background. Pure placement: it does NOT show or hide the overlay (M4).
withItemFormatter(\Closure $fn): selfSet the formatter for item display lines.
withNumbered(bool $numbered = true): selfTurn the printed ordinals on or off (-073).
withFilterFn(\Closure $fn): self
withRanker(?FuzzyMatcher $matcher): selfSet (or clear, with null) a sugar-fuzzy ranker. When set, a non-empty filter text ranks items by descending fuzzy score (true subsequence match) instead of the default contiguous-substring/anchor filter, and match highlighting follows the scored indices. The custom filterFn still applies as a predicate. Pass null to restore the default substring behaviour.
setPrompt(string $prompt): self
setMatchStyle(string $ansiStyle): self
setWindowHeight(int $h): self
setWindowWidth(int $w): self
setOffset(int $x, int $y): self
setItemFormatter(\Closure $fn): self
setFilterFn(\Closure $fn): self
setRanker(?FuzzyMatcher $matcher): self
withBorder(?Border $border): selfApply a border from sugar-style.
withStyle(?Style $style): selfApply a style from sugar-style.
withHelpBar(?HelpBar $helpBar): selfAttach a help bar below the filter list.
withStatusBar(?StatusBar $statusBar): selfAttach a status bar at the bottom of the overlay.
withOnResize(?\Closure $callback): selfRegister a callback to invoke after SIGWINCH resize events. The callback receives (cols: int, rows: int). Pass null to detach a previously registered callback (attachSigwinch() then returns false).
attachSigwinch(?callable $installer = null): boolAttach a SIGWINCH handler via SignalForwarder that queries the live TTY dimensions and forwards (cols, rows) to the stored $onResize callback.
invalidateAutoWidth(): voidDrop the memoized auto width so the next view() re-measures.
withTtySizeProvider(?\Closure $provider): selfInstall a geometry provider for ttySize() (see the property for the semantics). Clone-returning like every other builder; the provider is shared state for the clone family only in the sense that every fluent clone carries the same closure handle.

WidthMemo final class

Shared auto-width cache for one QuickPick clone family.

MethodSummary
invalidate(): voidDiscard the composed width so the next render re-derives it. Cheap: every ingredient (prompt, filter, cached per-item widths) is still warm.
invalidateItems(): voidDiscard the per-item measurements too — required when the corpus or the formatter closure itself changes, the only two events that make a stored item width wrong rather than merely unused.
